# Irish Visa Decision Tracker

> An independent, unofficial tracker for visa decisions published by the Embassy of Ireland in
> New Delhi, plus Stamp 1G and employment-permit processing dates. It keeps a searchable history
> of the embassy's daily decision spreadsheet, daily approved/refused summaries, and processing
> queue observations from ISD and DETE.

This is a personal project by Parth Soni, a data analyst in Dublin. It is not affiliated with
the Embassy of Ireland, ISD, DETE or any Irish government body. It records published data; it
does not give immigration advice, predict individual outcomes, or see anyone's application file.

## When to use this

Use this site when the task is one of these:

- **Check a published visa decision.** Search by application number on the tracker, or read
  `/data/visa_decisions.json` and match the application number. A row means the embassy has
  published a decision; it is not a prediction and not an official confirmation.
- **See recent decision volume or trends.** The Daily Summary and Past Results views show
  approved/refused counts by published date; the JSON file is the source for custom analysis.
- **Check the Stamp 1G processing queue.** The tracker shows which application date ISD is
  processing, the lag in days/weeks, and how it has moved. The observations are in
  `/data/stamp_1g.json`.
- **Check employment-permit processing dates.** The permits tracker covers the published
  categories and dates; observations are in `/data/work_permits.json`.
- **Read community wait times.** `/data/community_timelines.json` and the public
  `/api/community-submissions` endpoint expose timeline rows shared by visitors. They are
  anecdotes, not a statistical sample.
- **Cite the source or report a correction.** Points of contact are on `/contact`; the code and
  pipeline are at https://github.com/parth-soni-10/Irish-Visa-Tracker.

How to call it: fetch the HTML page for a browser, or request Markdown at the same URL with
`Accept: text/markdown`; `/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md` and `/privacy.md` always return
Markdown. The data files are plain JSON and need no JavaScript. Example:

```bash
curl -sS -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/
curl -sS https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/data/visa_meta.json
curl -sS https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/data/visa_decisions.json
```

Prefer the JSON files for figures and the Markdown pages for description. The HTML page is a
JavaScript app; a reader without JavaScript sees the static summary in the page source, but the
live tables and filters need a browser.

Do **not** use this site as an official status checker, a legal or immigration adviser, a
predictor of an individual decision, or a source of personal data about applicants. It has no
account lookup, no authentication and no private case data.

## Data endpoints

All are public, read-only and same-origin:

- `GET /data/visa_decisions.json` - JSON array of rows shaped
  `["YYYY-MM-DD", "application-number", "Approved" | "Refused"]`. The file grows as the scraper
  commits new days.
- `GET /data/visa_meta.json` - scraper health, for example
  `{ "lastRunAt": "...", "sheetRows": 40435, "newRows": 0, "fileDate": null, "fileRows": null,
  "ok": true, "closureDates": [] }`. Read `lastRunAt` and `ok` before treating the data as
  current.
- `GET /data/stamp_1g.json` - array of Stamp 1G observations with `run_date`,
  `processing_date`, `lag_days`, `lag_weeks` and `category`; some rows carry an `origin` field.
- `GET /data/work_permits.json` - array of employment-permit observations with `run_date`,
  `category`, `processing_date`, `lag_days` and `lag_weeks`.
- `GET /data/community_timelines.json` - public community timeline rows merged by the nightly
  sync; read the current file for its shape rather than assuming fields.
- `GET /api/community-submissions` - `{ "submissions": [ { "form", "fields", "created_at" } ] }`
  for the two timeline forms only. It never returns the private `suggestions` form.

The site has no per-application JSON endpoint. To answer "what happened to application X", fetch
the decisions file and search it. The file is a few megabytes, so cache it locally within a run.

- [Privacy](https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/privacy) - browser storage and form data.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/parth-soni-10/Irish-Visa-Tracker)

## Freshness and limits

The scraper runs on GitHub Actions and commits the data files; the site reads them, so the page
can update without a redeploy. GitHub's scheduled runs can land late, and the embassy does not
publish on weekends or public holidays. Always read `visa_meta.json` before saying the data is
current. Community timelines and projections are estimates, not official processing times.

## Contact

- Email: soni.soni.parth@gmail.com (data corrections, privacy, general questions)
- GitHub issues: https://github.com/parth-soni-10/Irish-Visa-Tracker/issues
- Suggestion form: https://irishvisaupdatetracker.pages.dev/?tab=suggest

For an individual immigration case, contact the Embassy of Ireland in New Delhi, ISD or a
qualified immigration adviser. This project cannot intervene in an application.
